# Open Questions Register — PP20

## Open questions

- Which pilot use case creates sufficient value to justify the first data product?
- Who owns semantic definitions, data quality, and interface decisions by domain?

## Prioritisation

Both questions are high priority because they determine feasible scope and accountable ownership.

## Owners

The intake buyer owns sponsor and pilot-scope decisions; the Data Governance Lead owns data-accountability clarification.

## Resolution methods

- Conduct sponsor and domain-owner interviews.
- Review current ownership, interface, and data-governance records.
